custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a vendor, vendor A.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Vendors in the left menu, then New Vendor; type ZZAUTOTEST PL C839424 VENDOR A in Name *, then click Save & Close.
  • Have an untracked part, part A, with vendor A, whose part number, description and tags contain neither the word not nor the word tracked.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C839424 PART A in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839424-A in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, pick vendor A under Vendor, click Track quantities and cost of goods off, type 1 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save.
  • Have a tracked part, part B, with vendor A, whose description contains the word NOTCHED, so the word not also matches it on its description.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C839424 NOTCHED PART B in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839424-B in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, pick vendor A under Vendor, type 1 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save.
  • Have a tracked part, part C, with vendor A, whose part number, description and tags contain neither word, so the search has a part it must leave out.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C839424 PART C in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839424-C in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, pick vendor A under Vendor, type 1 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save.
  • Start on the Create Return page (Parts in the top bar, Returns in the left menu, then the button that starts a new return).
